assertions.text: Describes grouping findings by target plugin (2 for git-kit, 1 for plugin-devkit)
Describes an AskUserQuestion naming both target plugins and their finding counts explicitly, not a bare yes/no
Describes building a separate Scope Manifest + Report Revision bundle per target plugin, never one combined dispatch spanning both
Describes invoking Skill(plugin-devkit:plugin-lifecycle-downstream) at its External Entry, not plugin-lifecycle-maintenance
No crash, malformed output, or contradiction of its own documented Phase 5 steps
